title: Night Prayer with Psalm 23 | The Lord Is My Shepherd, Rest in His Care
description:
Pray through Psalm 23, entrust your unfinished day to the Shepherd, and rest with gentle Scripture readings before sleep. KJV readings: Psalm 23:1-6; John 10:11; Isaiah 40:11; Matthew 11:28-30; Ezekiel 34:11-12; Psalm 100:3-5; Isaiah 49:9-10; Psalm 121:3-4; John 10:27-28; Psalm 36:5-9; Psalm 4:8; Psalm 3:5.

Chapters
0:00 Good evening
0:38 The Shepherd at the end of the day (Psalm 23:1)
1:43 John 10:11
3:25 Permission to lie down (Psalm 23:2)
5:32 Restoration and a faithful path (Psalm 23:3)
7:18 Isaiah 40:11
8:33 With me in the valley (Psalm 23:4)
10:55 A place at the table (Psalm 23:5)
13:19 Goodness and mercy beyond today (Psalm 23:6)
14:35 Declaration for today
15:05 One thing to do today
15:46 Scripture for sleep: gathered and kept
16:14 A gentle invitation (Matthew 11:28-30)
17:35 The Shepherd seeks his flock (Ezekiel 34:11-12)
18:48 The sheep of his pasture (Psalm 100:3-5)
20:17 Led by mercy (Isaiah 49:9-10)
21:49 The Keeper who does not sleep (Psalm 121:3-4)
23:04 Known by the Shepherd (John 10:27-28)
24:22 The fountain of life (Psalm 36:5-9)
25:57 A prayer from the pillow (Psalm 4:8)
26:38 Psalm 3:5
27:49 Rest in the Shepherd's care

Scripture in this prayer: Psalm 23:1; John 10:11; Psalm 23:2; Psalm 23:3; Isaiah 40:11; Psalm 23:4; Psalm 23:5; Psalm 23:6; Matthew 11:28-30; Ezekiel 34:11-12; Psalm 100:3-5; Isaiah 49:9-10; Psalm 121:3-4; John 10:27-28; Psalm 36:5-9; Psalm 4:8; Psalm 3:5
